Each record serves a specific purpose, such as mapping domain names to IP addresses, managing email servers, and providing essential domain information. DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) records are DNS records used to implement email authentication for a domain. They add a digital signature to outgoing emails using cryptographic keys.
